known_semantic_details: Union, Intersection, Subtraction, Difference take destination/left/right. Native permits destination aliasing an input; Rust borrow rules do not.
Unite, Intersect, Subtract, Differ are in-place bool operations. Native Intersect and Differ rebuild using a default hasher; Rust does likewise and tests a salted hasher.
Bool results report extent changes, not equality of complete key sets; symmetric difference can change keys yet return false if extent is unchanged.
